title: He said (that) he… He told me (that) he…
translation: 他（曾）说他…… 他（曾）告诉我说他……
description: A picture lesson on reported speech with 'would' and 'would have to'. Twelve pictures in four groups of three show direct speech being converted to reported speech using 'would', 'might', 'could', and 'had to'. The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 135 conversation using reported speech), B (answer 'What did he/she say?' with 'He/She said (that)…'), and C (answer 'What did he/she tell you?' with 'He/She told me (that)…'). The workbook drills reported-speech completion for short conversations and open-ended 'About you' writing; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences with 'said'/'told' and 'would', completes a reported-speech dialogue, and writes short reports from given facts.
answer_note: The listening captions are model answers (suggested). Textbook written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 135 conversation), B ('What did he/she say?'), and C ('What did he/she tell you?') are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (complete reported-speech conversations) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-135-141.jpg p.217); Workbook B ('About you') has no printed key, so the answers are model answers (suggested). Grammar I (rewrite with said/told and would), II (complete reported-speech dialogue), and III (write short reports) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.573-574).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

1. I will be at home at 6.
2. What did she say? What did she tell you?
3. She said (that) she would be at home at 6. She told me (that) she would be at home at 6.
4. I may come home early.
5. What did she say? What did she tell you?
6. She said (that) she might come home early. She told me (that) she might come home early.
7. I can run very fast.
8. What did she say? What did she tell you?
9. She said (that) she could run very fast. She told me (that) she could run very fast.
10. I have to go to school.
11. What did she say? What did she tell you?
12. She said (that) she had to go to school. She told me (that) she had to go to school.
lesson.translation: 1. 我6点在家。 2. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 3. 她（说）她6点在家。她告诉我（说）她6点在家。 4. 我可能早点回家。 5. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 6. 她（说）她可能早点回家。她告诉我（说）她可能早点回家。 7. 我能跑得很快。 8. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 9. 她（说）她能跑得很快。她告诉我（说）她能跑得很快。 10. 我不得不去上学。 11. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 12. 她（说）她不得不去上学。她告诉我（说）她不得不去上学。

lesson.title: Written A: Answer the questions (reported speech)
lesson.instruction: Read the report in Lesson 135 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 135 课的报道，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 重读第 135 课的报道，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 5 comprehension questions about the Lesson 135 report (Karen Marsh), answered using reported speech.

questions.prompt: What did Karen Marsh tell reporters?
questions.answer: She told reporters that she might retire.

questions.prompt: Did she say that she could, or couldn't make up her mind?
questions.answer: She said that she couldn't make up her mind.

questions.prompt: Who did she say she would have to ask?
questions.answer: She said that she would have to ask her future husband.

questions.prompt: Who did she say would not let her make another film?
questions.answer: She said that her future husband would not let her make another film.

questions.prompt: What did Michael Jones say?
questions.answer: He said that he would not let her make another film.

lesson.title: Written B: What did he/she say?
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 items; item 1 ('I will be at home at 6.' → She said (that) she would be at home at 6.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: 'I will be at home at 6.' → What did she say?
questions.answer: She said (that) she would be at home at 6.

questions.prompt: 'I may come home early.' → What did she say?
questions.answer: She said (that) she might come home early.

questions.prompt: 'I can run very fast.' → What did she say?
questions.answer: She said (that) she could run very fast.

questions.prompt: 'I have to go to school.' → What did she say?
questions.answer: She said (that) she had to go to school.

lesson.title: Written C: What did he/she tell you?
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 items; item 1 ('I will be at home at 6.' → She told me (that) she would be at home at 6.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: 'I will be at home at 6.' → What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She told me (that) she would be at home at 6.

questions.prompt: 'I may come home early.' → What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She told me (that) she might come home early.

questions.prompt: 'I can run very fast.' → What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She told me (that) she could run very fast.

questions.prompt: 'I have to go to school.' → What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She told me (that) she had to go to school.

practice.title: Practice A: Complete the conversations (reported speech)
practice.instruction: What did these people say? Complete these short conversations. 用间接引语完成以下对话。
practice.translation: 用间接引语完成以下对话。
practice.context: 5 conversations with 10 fill-in items (2 per conversation); item C1 (She said she might not be able to go tomorrow.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: A: 'I may not be able to go tomorrow.' B: 'What did she say?' C: She said she might not be able to go tomorrow.
questions.answer: She said she might not be able to go tomorrow.

questions.prompt: A: 'We won't go to town on Saturday.' B: 'What did they say?' C: They said (that) they wouldn't go to town on Saturday.
questions.answer: They said (that) they wouldn't go to town on Saturday.

questions.prompt: A: 'I can swim very well.' B: 'What did he say?' C: He said (that) he could swim very well.
questions.answer: He said (that) he could swim very well.

questions.prompt: A: 'My parents will be in London next week.' B: 'What did she tell you?' C: She told me (that) her parents would be in London the following week.
questions.answer: She told me (that) her parents would be in London the following week.

questions.prompt: A: 'I can't hear very well; it's so noisy.' B: 'What did he say?' C: He said (that) he couldn't hear very well because it was so noisy.
questions.answer: He said (that) he couldn't hear very well because it was so noisy.

practice.title: Practice B: About you
practice.instruction: Write down three or four things that your family or friends told you yesterday. Make sure you report what was said. 用间接引语形式记录家人或朋友昨天告诉你的三四件事。
practice.translation: 用间接引语形式记录家人或朋友昨天告诉你的三四件事。
practice.context: 4 open-ended personal writing items; the workbook answer key gives only possible sample answers.

questions.prompt: Write down one thing that your family or friends told you yesterday.
questions.answer: My friend told me that he couldn't go to the sports club.

questions.prompt: Write down one thing that your family or friends told you yesterday.
questions.answer: My sister told me she might stay with a friend this weekend.

questions.prompt: Write down one thing that your family or friends told you yesterday.
questions.answer: My father told us that we would go to see our grandparents on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Write down one thing that your family or friends told you yesterday.
questions.answer: My friend told me he was going to get a new bike.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences using 'said' or 'told'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 said 或 told 改写以下句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 said 或 told 改写以下句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.573 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 6 sentence-rewrite items; item 1 (I'll tell you the secret. (she, me) → She told me (that) she would tell me the secret.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I'll tell you the secret. (she, me)
questions.answer: She told me (that) she would tell me the secret.

questions.prompt: We'll see you at the office. (they, him)
questions.answer: They told him (that) they would see him at the office.

questions.prompt: You may leave when you want to. (the doctor, his patient)
questions.answer: The doctor told his patient (that) he might leave when he wanted to.

questions.prompt: I'll phone you this evening. (his wife, him)
questions.answer: His wife told him (that) she would phone him that evening.

questions.prompt: We may be late for the train. (they, me)
questions.answer: They told me (that) they might be late for the train.

questions.prompt: I'll help you with your homework. (her, me)
questions.answer: She told me (that) she would help me with my homework.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Complete the dialogue (reported speech)
grammar.instruction: 完成以下对话，填入适当的词（间接引语）。
grammar.translation: 完成以下对话，填入适当的词（间接引语）。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.573-574 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 fill-in items in a dialogue between a man and a woman about holiday plans.

questions.prompt: Woman: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year? Man: (reported speech)
questions.answer: He said that he was going to spend his holidays in the country.

questions.prompt: Man: How are you going to get there? Woman: (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she was going to get there by train.

questions.prompt: Woman: Who are you going to stay with? Man: (reported speech)
questions.answer: He said that he was going to stay with his uncle and aunt.

questions.prompt: Man: What are you going to do there? Woman: (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she was going to go swimming every day.

questions.prompt: Woman: How long are you going to stay? Man: (reported speech)
questions.answer: He said that he was going to stay for a week.

questions.prompt: Man: Are you going to travel abroad? Woman: (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she was not going to travel abroad.

questions.prompt: Woman: Why not? Man: (reported speech)
questions.answer: He said that he was not going to travel abroad because it was too expensive.

questions.prompt: Man: What are you going to do in the evenings? Woman: (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she was going to read and listen to the radio.

questions.prompt: Woman: Are you going to write to us? Man: (reported speech)
questions.answer: He said that he was going to write to them every day.

questions.prompt: Man: When are you coming back? Woman: (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she was coming back on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Woman: Will you bring us any presents? Man: (reported speech)
questions.answer: He said that he would bring them some presents.

questions.prompt: Man: Are you sure you'll enjoy yourself? Woman: (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she was sure she would enjoy herself.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Write a short report
grammar.instruction: 根据所给事实写一个简短的报道（用间接引语）。
grammar.translation: 根据所给事实写一个简短的报道（用间接引语）。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.574 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 short-report items; each item gives a fact to be reported using 'said' or 'told' with 'would'.

questions.prompt: The doctor told me that I would have to stay in hospital for a week.
questions.answer: The doctor told me that I would have to stay in hospital for a week.

questions.prompt: The doctor said that I might be able to go home on Friday.
questions.answer: The doctor said that I might be able to go home on Friday.

questions.prompt: The doctor said that I would have to have an operation.
questions.answer: The doctor said that I would have to have an operation.

questions.prompt: The doctor told me that I could leave the hospital on Monday.
questions.answer: The doctor told me that I could leave the hospital on Monday.

questions.prompt: The doctor said that I would have to rest for a few days.
questions.answer: The doctor said that I would have to rest for a few days.

questions.prompt: The doctor told me that I might be able to work again in a month.
questions.answer: The doctor told me that I might be able to work again in a month.

questions.prompt: The doctor said that I would have to take some medicine.
questions.answer: The doctor said that I would have to take some medicine.

questions.prompt: The doctor told me that I could go for a walk every day.
questions.answer: The doctor told me that I could go for a walk every day.

questions.prompt: The doctor said that I would have to come back for another examination.
questions.answer: The doctor said that I would have to come back for another examination.

questions.prompt: The doctor told me that I might be able to drive again in a few weeks.
questions.answer: The doctor told me that I might be able to drive again in a few weeks.

questions.prompt: The doctor said that I would have to avoid heavy work.
questions.answer: The doctor said that I would have to avoid heavy work.

questions.prompt: The doctor told me that I could have a short holiday in the summer.
questions.answer: The doctor told me that I could have a short holiday in the summer.

l136-pictures.description: Twelve numbered pictures in a 4x3 grid, each group of three showing: 1 a person saying a sentence with 'will/may/can/have to'; 2 a question mark bubble 'What did she say?'; 3 the same person with a speech bubble showing reported speech. Four groups illustrate: will → would, may → might, can → could, have to → had to.
